rows.meaning: Sending logit_bias as a JSON object returns 200 but generation_settings.logit_bias is normalized to an array of {"bias", "token"} objects, keeping only tokens in [0, n_vocab), so a client must read back the array form and may not assume an out-of-vocabulary token was applied.

source.quote: new field_json("logit_bias") ... "Accepts an array of [token, bias] pairs or an object mapping token to bias." ... ctx.params.sampling.logit_bias.push_back({tok, bias});

rows.meaning: Setting ignore_eos true returns 200 with generation_settings.ignore_eos true and, because the handler appends the precomputed EOG biases, injects token 2 into generation_settings.logit_bias with a null (minus-infinity) bias that the client never sent.

source.quote: new field_bool("ignore_eos", params.sampling.ignore_eos) ... "Ignore the end-of-sequence token and continue generating" ... ctx.params.sampling.logit_bias.insert(

rows.meaning: Sending stop as a bare string returns 200 with generation_settings.stop wrapped into a one-element array, while an empty string is echoed as a [""] stopping entry and an empty array clears it, so a client should read back the echoed array instead of assuming rejection or clearing.

source.quote: new field_json("stop") ... "Specify stopping strings. Generation stops when one is produced, and the string is not included in the output" ... ctx.params.antiprompt.push_back(stop.get<std::string>());

rows.meaning: Sending samplers as the string "kp" returns 200 with generation_settings.samplers resolved to ["top_k", "top_p"], while unknown sampler names are silently dropped (an all-unknown array becomes []), so a client must read back the array and cannot assume the requested chain applied.

source.quote: field_json("samplers") ... "The order in which samplers are applied. An array of sampler type names, or a single string of sampler chars" ... common_sampler_types_from_chars(samplers.get<std::string>())
